summary: End-to-end UI testing of the new Boost (Sponsorisé) monetization feature on the Immobilier module — user boost flow + admin Plans de Boost CRUD. All flows pass.
tests_performed: User login (rider.qa@demo.sb) succeeds and lands on /home

/real-estate/post: post-country select present with 4 options (FR/MQ/GP/GF). Listing 'Studio Test Boost QA' (FR, 150000€) created successfully, redirected to /real-estate/my with toast 'Annonce publiée !'
/real-estate/my: my-boost-<id> gradient 'Booster mon annonce' button visible on owned active non-featured listings (2 listings)
Clicking my-boost-<id> opens boost-modal showing 3 plans (boost-plan-<id>) — Boost 7 jours 4,99€, Boost 15 jours 8,99€, Boost 30 jours 14,99€
Clicking a boost-plan-<id> redirects to checkout.stripe.com (real cs_test_ session URL). Stripe checkout shows '€4.99 Payment'. Payment not completed (optional per spec).
Both tabs present: admin-re-tab-listings (default) and admin-re-tab-boost
Listings tab shows table with filter chips re-admin-filter-all/active/inactive/sold/rented (all present)
Boost tab: 15 seeded boost-plan-row-<id> displayed grouped by country (FR/GF/GP/MQ + Par défaut), each with durée/prix/priorité/statut
boost-plan-add opens boost-plan-modal with all fields (country/currency/duration/price/priority/label). Save creates a new row, toast 'Plan enregistré'
boost-plan-toggle-<id> flips Actif↔Inactif correctly (Inactif badge appears)
boost-plan-edit-<id> opens modal with values prefilled (duration=5, price=2.99)
boost-plan-delete-<id> triggers native confirm 'Supprimer ce plan ?', DELETE returns 200, row removed, toast 'Supprimé'. Row count returns to 15 (seeded baseline).
critical_code_review_comments: Native window.confirm used for delete confirmation — acceptable for admin but consider a styled ConfirmDialog for UX consistency with other admin sections (non-blocking).

post-type / post-category are rendered as segmented buttons (Acheter/Louer, Résidentiel/Commercial/Terrain) without a data-testid wrapper; not blocking since defaults work, but adding post-type/post-category testids would help future automation.
seed_data_creation: Created listing 'Studio Test Boost QA' (FR, 150000€) under rider.qa@demo.sb to exercise the boost button. Created and then deleted an admin TEST_QA Boost 5j plan (final state: 15 seeded plans intact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Boost feature fully functional end-to-end on UI. Stripe checkout redirect verified (cs_test_ URL). Optional post-payment ★ Sponsorisé badge verification requires completing 4242 test card payment — not executed here but backend logic is idempotent and pre-verified per main agent.
